name: Radar PPI
desc: A surveillance radar plan-position indicator: the sweep rakes around the tube painting a hot coastline, drifting weather cells and labelled aircraft tracks into the phosphor, and the whole return decays behind it into a long trailing wedge while the bearing scale, bezel and readouts sit engraved on a lit console panel.

density.doc: number of aircraft tracks and weather cells

persist.doc: phosphor decay time — how far the trailing wedge reaches

clutter.doc: sea clutter, receiver speckle and weather intensity

hue.doc: trace + ground hue (offset from the style anchor)

style.doc: aesthetic: P7 green phosphor on a lit console / amber CRT / printed drafting plot with no glow / ironbow false-colour returns / hard white vector on graphite

act.doc: multi-minute programme: steady watch / tracks converging on the scope centre / heavy weather swamping the returns
